auditor_provenance.limitation: This is a fresh, role-separated audit, but it is not human-distinct, model-family-distinct, or provider-distinct. Same-family correlated-error risk remains, so this artifact is an audit finding rather than an independence certificate.

governing_semantics.criterion_rule: The roadmap verification_criteria text is immutable. Phase 1 may operationalize that criterion but may not add a required acceptance condition; any such addition is a new standard and is advisory unless separately escalated under the protocol.
governing_semantics.verdict_rule: Phase-2A verdicts are assessed against the exact immutable roadmap criterion. FULLY_ADDRESSED requires every conjunct; PARTIALLY_ADDRESSED requires genuine but incomplete satisfaction and a residual gap; consider items are decision-inert.

summary.headline: Paper 29 has no semantic verdict discrepancy. Paper 30 item REV-EIC-W4 is undergraded because Phase 1 added a provenance-separation condition not present in the immutable criterion; under the exact criterion it is FULLY_ADDRESSED. Both papers remain Major Revision by B4.

immutable_criterion.text: The contribution-positioning text names the comparison set, states the distinct unit of contribution, labels adaptations versus synthesis, and makes no unsupported global novelty claim.

phase1.reason: The named comparison classes and the adaptation-versus-project-specific-synthesis distinction are item-specific operational detail, not a new acceptance requirement.

row_audits.rationale: B0087 names certificate methods, proof-carrying computation, and replay-oriented workflow design as the comparison classes, isolates the contribution as a project-specific synthesis, and disclaims global originality; B0091 also disclaims field-wide priority. All criterion conjuncts are present.

immutable_criterion.text: The main method is understandable without project-internal phase or route vocabulary, and any retained workflow history is clearly separated as provenance rather than scientific method.

phase1.reason: The operationalization directly instantiates the criterion's project-internal vocabulary and retained-workflow-history clauses.

row_audits.rationale: B0048 removes phase/checkpoint/route labels, but B0049 still places editorial, domain, methodology, adversarial-review, and author-adjudication history inside the executed-method account without identifying it as a separate provenance surface. The partial verdict and should-fix residual are supported.

immutable_criterion.text: Every artifact invoked as an audit basis has a stable locator, version or content digest, access condition, and explicit claim-surface relationship, or the auditability claim is narrowed to what readers can actually inspect.

phase1.reason: Reader-resolvability and claim-surface scoping restate stable-locator and inspectability requirements without extending them.

row_audits.rationale: B0080 supplies a commit-pinned reader locator, four exact paths and SHA-256 digests, and a bounded claim-surface statement; B0107 states availability and identifies unavailable evidence classes. The auditability claim is expressly limited to what can be inspected.

immutable_criterion.text: The reported corpus counts replay from the disclosed row-level ledger, and the final 22 admitted identifiers are hash-linked to the evidence matrix without implying a broader search than was executed.

phase1.reason: The detailed ledger fields are the concrete evidence needed for the criterion's row-level count replay and hash-link requirement.

row_audits.rationale: The revision adds queries, dates, normalization, deduplication, admitted identifiers, and aggregate reconciliation, but B0048, B0089, and B0107 expressly say that screened-out row identifiers/decisions and a complete run log are absent. Full row-level replay and the required row-level join therefore remain unavailable.

immutable_criterion.text: Each decision-bearing source-role claim either carries an exact passage locator, hypothesis map, and prohibited-transfer note or is explicitly narrowed while retaining an INCONCLUSIVE claim-to-passage status.

phase1.reason: The operationalization preserves the criterion's two alternative permitted paths without adding a third requirement.

row_audits.rationale: All 22 decision-bearing source-role paragraphs take the permitted narrowing path: each states a bounded use, retains INCONCLUSIVE passage status, and states a prohibited stronger transfer. B0091 preserves the same boundary globally.

immutable_criterion.text: The prospective replay boundary states closed input and receipt schemas, verifier predicates, code-reuse constraints, fixture classes with expected outcomes, and the unchanged fact that no replay has been executed.

phase1.reason: The specific positive, negative, malformed, inversion, root, and timeout fixture classes instantiate the criterion's fixture-class clause and are traceable to the same roadmap item's frozen remedy.

row_audits.rationale: B0064-B0068 name versioned ledger/receipt schemas and their required fields, validator acceptance or rejection predicates, typed fixture classes with predeclared dispositions, and the replay receipt; B0068/B0081 impose the producer-verifier reuse boundary. Every block states that the artifacts and replay are unexecuted. At the prospective specification level required by the criterion, the conjuncts are satisfied.

immutable_criterion.text: The Gate-M contract contains an explicit covariance or invariance equation, defines the tested predicate and its scope, and prevents a failed candidate from becoming a universal nonexistence claim.

phase1.reason: The operationalization makes the requested Gate-M equation and candidate-specific scope concrete without extending the criterion.

row_audits.rationale: B0046 states the conjugacy and inversion equations, distinguishes Gaussian conjugation, and confines refutation to the registered candidate and literal codomain. B0058-B0059 bind the declared predicates and dispositions to the same limited scope.

immutable_criterion.text: A single reader-facing surface maps every named object and transformation to its type, gate, stop state, and downstream restriction without presenting prospective nodes as executed artifacts.

phase1.reason: The enumerated objects and transformations are the roadmap item's named vocabulary and do not add a distinct standard.

row_audits.rationale: B0112 supplies a consolidated typed dependency chain, gate relations, prospective status, and a generic downstream prohibition. It does not assign an explicit stop state separately to every mapped object or transformation, so partial rather than full satisfaction is correct.

immutable_criterion.text: Every named control is mapped to the failure class it can diagnose, the conclusions it cannot support, and the stop state produced by failure, while all result cells remain explicitly unexecuted.

phase1.reason: The named failure classes and prohibited conclusions operationalize the exact three-part control interpretation requirement.

row_audits.rationale: B0113 maps each named control to a diagnosis and a prohibited inference and states that no control has run, but it omits an explicit terminal stop state for each failure. The recorded partial verdict identifies exactly that missing conjunct.

immutable_criterion.text: Every Gate-M failure maps to one deterministic terminal record, including the case in which formal-law and split-branch predicates both hold.

phase1.reason: The disjoint-predicate-or-precedence formulation is an equivalent operationalization of deterministic serialization.

row_audits.rationale: B0059 gives split-branch failure precedence, records formal_map_refuted=true in the overlap case, and provides distinct dispositions for the remaining cases, yielding exactly one primary terminal record.

immutable_criterion.text: The manuscript either contains a clearly labeled synthetic fixture with a stated baseline and diagnostic outcome or limits the usefulness claim to a prospective organizational benefit without implying demonstrated scientific value.

phase1.reason: The operationalization preserves the criterion's disjunctive fixture-or-narrowing paths.

row_audits.rationale: The revision validly takes the narrowing branch: B0081 says fixtures are specifications, not executed tests, and B0087 confines usefulness to prospective organization while explicitly leaving practical usefulness and scientific performance unevaluated.

immutable_criterion.text: The revised positioning names the comparison basis and separates supported novelty from established practice; unsupported novelty language is narrowed, no named-venue or submission-readiness claim is introduced, and A0_FAIL / A2_NOT_ELIGIBLE / NO_ROUTE_PROMOTION remains unchanged.

phase1.reason: The operationalization restates the comparison, novelty-boundary, venue/readiness, and exact route-state conjuncts.

row_audits.rationale: B0013/B0105 narrow the contribution to project-specific integration, distinguish constituent established ideas, and deny unsupported novelty/significance; B0116 preserves the exact route state. No closest comparison framework or bounded comparison set is actually named, so partial with a must-fix residual is supported.

immutable_criterion.text: A reader can resolve one persistent locator, verify an exact manifest of the admitted artifacts, replay the documented search/screening decisions at row level, and inspect claim-level evidence fields; unavailable artifacts are stated as unavailable rather than implied to be accessible, and no scientific execution or Route credit is asserted.

phase1.reason: The query, row-ledger, passage, hypothesis, correction, and prohibited-transfer fields operationalize the criterion's replay and claim-level-inspection operations.

row_audits.rationale: B0098 supplies a commit-pinned locator and four hashes, while B0059-B0062 expose bounded search metadata and availability limits. The text expressly confirms that excluded-row decisions, passage adjudications, and complete correction entries are unavailable, so row-level replay and claim-level inspection remain incomplete.

immutable_criterion.text: Both correction DOIs have complete independently resolvable bibliography entries, P30-S01/P30-S02 are bound to 10.1063/1.457669, P30-S03 is bound to 10.1063/1.457670, and the manuscript no longer describes correction provenance as publication-incomplete. Resolution requires separate author authority for any references.bib change.

phase1.reason: The operationalization preserves every DOI mapping, bibliography-entry, publication-status, and authority condition verbatim in substance.

row_audits.rationale: The exact source-to-correction mappings were added, but B0060/B0106 say both correction DOIs still lack standalone bibliography entries and retain publication-incomplete status. The author sidecar authorizes only B0060 and B0106, not references.bib; it is used here only to confirm the mutation boundary.

immutable_criterion.text: The section remains auditable but can be read without knowledge of internal Phase-2 through Phase-6 workflow names; corpus scope, screening, correction handling, source-role coding, synthesis limits, and the no-scientific-execution boundary remain explicit.

phase1.reason: The operationalization adds the independent acceptance condition 'any retained internal history is separated as provenance.' The immutable criterion requires removal of dependence on internal Phase-2 through Phase-6 names while preserving specified audit facts; it does not require generic descriptions of editorial/domain/methodology/adversarial assessment to be removed from the method or separately labeled as provenance. This added conjunct should have been advisory new_standard material rather than part of the verdict yardstick.

row_audits.rationale: The revised executed-method section contains no internal Phase-2 through Phase-6 names. B0059 states corpus scope and screening, B0060 correction handling, B0059/B0061 source-role coding and synthesis, B0062 the evidence ceiling, and B0061/B0066 the no-scientific-execution boundary. B0061's generic statement that the synthesis was assessed from four scholarly perspectives before author adjudication is intelligible without internal workflow names and violates no immutable-criterion conjunct. The recorded residual depends only on the added Phase-1 condition, so the exact-criterion verdict is FULLY_ADDRESSED.

immutable_criterion.text: The template is type-checkable at the level of named mathematical fields, shows one composed inequality and dependency ledger, distinguishes all five raw channels, declares every absent constant or theorem as not evaluable, and reports no numerical enclosure or scientific result.

phase1.reason: The listed spaces, norms, maps, constants, domain, output, conditioning, dependencies, and failure fields instantiate the type-checkability requirement stated in the criterion and item.

row_audits.rationale: B0075-B0077 name the typed mathematical fields, five channels, conditioning and composition map, display the composed inequality, state the dependency rule, and yield ERROR_CONTRACT_NOT_EVALUABLE on missing fields. B0082 enumerates the field ledger and marks all absent values UNASSIGNED without claiming an enclosure.

immutable_criterion.text: Every named control is a deterministic lawful roof construction with frozen parameters; the matrix identifies preserved and broken properties, tested invariant, comparison statistic, tolerance, failure diagnosis, and prohibited conclusion; it explicitly states that no control result exists.

phase1.reason: The operationalization carries forward each named control and every required matrix field without adding an unrelated condition.

row_audits.rationale: B0084/B0103 define lawful symbolic control forms, interpretations, the comparison functional, tolerance contract, dispositions, and no-result boundary. However the shuffle automorphism, unit constant, geometry delta, complex domain, and thresholds remain UNASSIGNED, so the controls are not frozen deterministic instances. Partial with a must-fix residual is correct.

immutable_criterion.text: Two readers applying the stated policy to the same admitted collision word obtain the same code class, physical orbit owner, orientation/reversal treatment, repetition count, and determinant multiplicity; no orbit or coefficient is claimed to have been computed.

phase1.reason: The coding, rotation, reversal, disk-label, repetition, multiplicity, realization, and no-computation clauses are exactly the policy dimensions needed for the criterion's deterministic-reader test.

row_audits.rationale: B0009 fixes labeled coding, cyclic rotation, reversal, disk-label symmetry, owner/repetition and multiplicity rules, and the realized-orbit witness, while expressly reporting no constructed record. B0069 and B0089 bind the same conventions to Gate 1 and independent replay.

immutable_criterion.text: One consolidated surface names all six gates and every required input, output, hash, uncertainty channel, receipt, consumer, and permission; the current state is represented without collapsing not-started and prerequisite-blocked gates into an ambiguous open label, and no gate is promoted by prose.

phase1.reason: The closed state vocabulary and per-gate field list reproduce the consolidated-surface criterion without changing its threshold.

row_audits.rationale: At the prospective-specification level required, B0088 provides one six-gate DAG surface with per-gate inputs/outputs and the mandatory hash, uncertainty, receipt, consumer, and prohibited-claim fields, while B0090 applies the closed state vocabulary to every current gate and distinguishes NOT_STARTED from PREREQUISITE_BLOCKED and terminal states. No gate is promoted.

immutable_criterion.text: The manuscript contains one unambiguous minimum-certificate definition, one Gate-6 activation rule, and one completion rule for both activated and non-activated cases; optionality cannot be read as a silent waiver, and no nontransfer result or Route credit is claimed.

phase1.reason: The roof-pair, relation, theorem-map, and mismatch fields make the requested activation rule exact and are traceable to the same roadmap item.

row_audits.rationale: B0118 defines the minimum certificate as Gates 1-5 passed in one hash-linked chain. B0086 supplies the exact pre-result activation record, NOT_ACTIVATED no-waiver semantics, and the two activated terminal outcomes. B0086/B0116/B0118 disclaim a nontransfer result and preserve no Route credit.
